snippet.title: Tom Bilyeu
snippet.description: Impact Theory is committed to an unbiased pursuit of the truth. Tom Bilyeu approaches the most important issues in world affairs, finance, AI and Future tech, and mindset by breaking down these complex topics into their fundamental elements. By doing so and by connecting with some of the brightest minds of our time, he helps the audience develop a useful framework for how the world really works.
